description: This file defines an internal class 'CounterAggregator' used for collecting and aggregating counter metrics with optional tagging support in Orleans runtime. It provides methods to add measurements and retrieve the current value along with associated tags.

classes.name: CounterAggregator
classes.description: A class for aggregating counter metrics with tagging support, allowing adding measurements and collecting the current value with tags.

methods.name: CounterAggregator()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty tags array.

methods.name: CounterAggregator(in TagList tagList)
methods.description: Constructor initializing tags based on provided TagList object, supporting up to four tags.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property returning the current aggregated value.

methods.name: Add(long measurement)
methods.description: Method to add a measurement to the current counter in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Collect()
methods.description: Method to collect the current value along with associated tags as a Measurement object.
